reasons: Both answers reject the 'contract signed, nothing to be done' premise, split the 3 statutory days (300%) from the 4 rest days (200%), and reach the right totals: 3724.14 + 3310.34 = 7034.48 yuan on top of the 9000 salary. Both lose points for putting a figure on scenario B's 150% (about 2482.76 yuan, range up to about 6207 yuan), which the key says cannot be computed. B rebuts the user's premise in its first sentence and cites Labor Contract Law Art 26. It also says the 4 rest days drop out if comp leave was given, notes that Oct 3 falls on a Saturday but is still a statutory holiday, and that arbitration is free. Its three links I opened (Fengtai court article, Beijing wage regulation, Third Intermediate Court judge's formula) all exist and support what B says. A cites more of the approval rules (Labor Law Art 39, 157号, the 2019 case) and names the make-up workdays. But it is much longer, with a rebuttal list and padding, and it adds citations I could not verify or that look misnumbered (271号 article numbers, 鲁民再154号, 北京高院 Art 56).
